selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What did the king decide to build?
questions.answer: A huge and beautiful palace.

questions.question: How did the king make the palace look special?
questions.answer: He filled it with jewels, beauty, and skillful art.

questions.question: What did the king place in the palace after finishing it?
questions.answer: Big tables of tasty food and many blessings.

questions.question: Who did the king invite to the palace?
questions.answer: His people and subjects from all over his land.

questions.question: Why did the king choose a chief leader as a teacher?
questions.answer: To explain the palace, its maker, and the meanings inside it.

questions.question: What were the helpers of the teacher doing in different parts of the palace?
questions.answer: They were helping teach people in each area.

questions.question: Where did the main teacher stay?
questions.answer: In the biggest room with his students.

questions.question: What kinds of things was the teacher supposed to explain about the palace?
questions.answer: Its decorations, jewels, art, secrets, and proper manners there.

questions.question: Why did the teacher teach the people the right way to act?
questions.answer: So they would behave the way the king wanted.

questions.question: What was the king’s purpose in building the palace?
questions.answer: He wanted a grand place to show many wonderful things.

questions.question: How was the palace divided inside?
questions.answer: Into many fine rooms and living spaces.

questions.question: What did the king use from his treasures in the palace?
questions.answer: Many kinds of precious jewels.

questions.question: How can we tell the king was very generous?
questions.answer: He prepared rich meals and invited many people.

questions.question: What was special about the food tables?
questions.answer: Each group had a table made for them.

questions.question: Besides food, what else were the guests meant to do?
questions.answer: Look at the amazing palace.

questions.question: What important job did the teacher have?
questions.answer: To tell the people the palace’s purpose and what its things meant.

questions.question: Why did people need someone to explain the palace?
questions.answer: Because its beauty and details had meanings they might not know by themselves.

questions.question: What did the teacher explain about the jewels and decorations?
questions.answer: That they pointed to the owner’s skill and greatness.

questions.question: What did the king do first with the palace?
questions.answer: He had a great palace made.

questions.question: How did the king decorate the palace?
questions.answer: With fine art, wisdom, and valuable jewels.

questions.question: What was set on the tables in the palace?
questions.answer: Delicious foods and many gifts.

questions.question: Who came to the feast and show?
questions.answer: The king’s people from every part of his country.

questions.question: Whom did the king appoint after preparing the palace?
questions.answer: A highest leader to be a teacher.

questions.question: What did the teacher explain about the art inside the palace?
questions.answer: What it was pointing to and what it showed.

title: 11 Word Construction of the Palace and Appointment of the Explaining Master
